A few useful details

Before you print.

How do I print the heart coloring page?

Open the coloring page and use its print button. It prepares the activity sheet for printing; the answers remain on the web page.

Who are the anatomy foundations PDFs for?

Students beginning anatomy or revisiting its basic directional language. The focus is intentionally narrow: ten directional terms, body planes, and anatomical position.

How should I print the PDFs?

Use US Letter paper and 100% scale. The exercises leave room for handwritten answers. You can also keep the PDFs open and answer in a notebook.

Are the answer keys included?

Yes. The worksheet has an answer page, and the practice pack has two answer-key pages with short explanations.

Can I use these with my course notes?

Yes. Use your course requirements as the guide. This collection includes common synonyms, such as frontal/coronal and transverse/axial.
